## Complete Degree-6 $E_1 + E_2$ Exclusion over $\mathbb{C}$: Kramers-Bridge Cascade, Factored Casimir Modes & Rank-9 Diagonal Quotient ($\deg D \ge 7$)

Following up on [our degree-$\le 5$ baseline and deformed Nambu/Casimir audit above](https://github.com/hodge-computer/sextics/discussions/127#discussioncomment-19049585), we have completed the full degree-6 $E_1$ and $E_2$ elimination pipeline for `one-reflection-skew`:

$$F = \sum_{i=0}^2 (X_i^6 + Y_i^6) + X_0^3 X_1 Y_0 Y_1 + X_1^3 X_2 Y_0 Y_1 + \frac{1}{7} X_0 X_1 Y_0 Y_1 (Y_0^2 - Y_1^2), \qquad A = X_0^3 Y_0^3, \qquad q = 1.$$

Every matrix rank, rational dual functional, Koszul syzygy lift, and Macaulay power identity is verified in exact arithmetic over $\mathbb{Q}$ in [`experiments/one_reflection_skew_degree6.py`](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/2aa95c5e4754547cdfdc6bf0a08bc8536e0aee05/experiments/one_reflection_skew_degree6.py) (detailed note: [`notes/one-reflection-skew-degree6.md`](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/blob/2aa95c5e4754547cdfdc6bf0a08bc8536e0aee05/notes/one-reflection-skew-degree6.md); proof packets in [`results/one-reflection-skew-degree6/`](https://github.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/tree/2aa95c5e4754547cdfdc6bf0a08bc8536e0aee05/results/one-reflection-skew-degree6)).

![one-reflection-skew degree-6 exclusion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rbajaj5/hodge-lab/2aa95c5e4754547cdfdc6bf0a08bc8536e0aee05/results/one-reflection-skew-degree6/one-reflection-skew-degree6-exclusion.png)

---

### 1. Stage 1 — Complete Degree-6 $E_1$ Kernel Equals $J_6(F)$ ($0$ Extra Directions)

In $S_{12}$ ($\dim = 6{,}188$), the degree-6 Jacobian multiplication map $J_{12}: (S_7)^6 \to S_{12}$ ($4{,}752$ columns) has exact rank $4{,}437$, and the augmented map $[J_{12} \mid A S_6]$ ($462$ denominator columns) has rank $4{,}863$. Hence the image of $D \mapsto [AD]$ in $S_{12}/J_{12}$ has rank $4{,}863 - 4{,}437 = 426$, and
$$\dim\ker\big(S_6 \xrightarrow{D \mapsto [AD]} S_{12}/J_{12}\big) = 462 - 426 = 36 = \dim J_6(F).$$

- **Comparison across instances:** Unlike `cyclic` and `fano` (where $\dim\ker(E_1)_6 = 38$, leaving two non-Jacobian directions) or `mixed-biweight` ($\dim\ker(E_1)_6 = 39$), the reflection-breaking perturbation $\frac{1}{7}X_0 X_1 Y_0 Y_1(Y_0^2 - Y_1^2)$ coupled to the cubic chain $X_0^3 X_1 Y_0 Y_1 + X_1^3 X_2 Y_0 Y_1$ closes all non-Jacobian $E_1$ channels at degree 6 (`2,024,352` exact Jacobian annihilation pairings verified).
- Every degree-6 solution of $AD = \nabla F \cdot N_0$ therefore takes the form
  $$D = \sum_{i,j=0}^5 M_{ij} Z_j \frac{\partial F}{\partial Z_i}, \qquad N_{0,i} = A \sum_{j=0}^5 M_{ij} Z_j + K_i, \qquad K \in \ker(J_{12}).$$

---

### 2. Stage 2 — Two-Step Hessian $E_2$ Cascade in $S_{12}/J_{12}$ & the Kramers-Bridge Doublet

1. **Degree-7 Koszul Syzygy Completeness:** The $15 \times 21 = 315$ quadratic multiples of the elementary Koszul fields $e_{ij} = (\partial_j F)\epsilon_i - (\partial_i F)\epsilon_j$ have exact rank $315 = 4{,}752 - 4{,}437 = \dim\ker(J_{12})$. Because $B_D(K) \equiv 0 \pmod{J_{12}}$ for every $D \in J_6(F)$ and $K \in \mathrm{Span}(e_{ij})$, the projection of $B_D(N_0)$ to $S_{12}/J_{12}$ depends purely quadratically on the $35$ gauged matrix entries $M_{ij}$ ($(i,j) \ne (5,5)$ after fixing the Euler/$F$ gauge $M_{55} = 0$).
2. **Step 1 (`rank = 236` on $630$ quadratic columns):** Exports **28** exact rational dual functionals isolating $M_{ij}^2 = 0$ for 28 of the 30 off-diagonal entries.
3. **Step 2 (`rank = 15` on $28$ quadratic columns — Kramers-Bridge Doublet):** The only two off-diagonal parameters surviving Step 1 are the **Kramers-bridge couplings**
   $$M_{13} \leftrightarrow (X_1, Y_0) \quad\text{and}\quad M_{14} \leftrightarrow (X_1, Y_1),$$
   which couple the linear bridge node $X_1$ directly to the Kramers doublet $(Y_0, Y_1)$ in both $X_0^3 X_1 Y_0 Y_1$ and $\frac{1}{7}X_0 X_1 Y_0 Y_1(Y_0^2 - Y_1^2)$. Once the 28 off-diagonals vanish at Step 1, restricting the Hessian quotient to the 7 surviving parameters isolates $M_{13}^2 = 0$ and $M_{14}^2 = 0$ (`142,560` exact Jacobian annihilation pairings and `30` mutation rejections verified).
4. **Step 3 (`rank = 4` on $15$ diagonal columns $a_i a_j$ in $S_{12}/J_{12}$):** With all 30 off-diagonal entries zero, $M = \mathrm{diag}(a_0, a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4, 0)$. Before even enforcing the 315 Koszul corrections in $S_{12}$, the pure Hessian quotient in $S_{12}/J_{12}$ yields a 4-dimensional quadratic system spanned by three transparent factored modes plus one anchor quadric:
   $$\begin{aligned}
   9\,Q_{\text{node}} &= (3 a_1 - a_2 - a_3 - a_4)^2 + 2\big[(a_2 - a_3)^2 + (a_3 - a_4)^2 + (a_4 - a_2)^2\big] = 0, \\
   Q_{\text{Kramers}} &= (a_3 - a_4)(a_0 + a_1 - a_3 - a_4) = 0, \\
   Q_{\text{bridge}} &= (a_0 - a_3)(a_0 - a_1 + a_3 - a_4) = 0.
   \end{aligned}$$
   Notice that over $\mathbb{R}$, the chain-node Casimir $Q_{\text{node}} = 0$ (generated by the $X_1^3 X_2 Y_0 Y_1$ vertex) is a **positive-definite sum of squares** in the relative weights $(a_2 - a_3,\, a_3 - a_4,\, 3a_1 - a_2 - a_3 - a_4)$, which by itself forces $a_1 = a_2 = a_3 = a_4$ over $\mathbb{R}$.

---

### 3. Stage 3 — Rank-9 Full Diagonal $E_2$ System & Cubic/Quartic Macaulay Exclusion over $\mathbb{C}$

Retaining the full $E_2$ condition $B_D(N_0) \in F S_6$ in $S_{12}$ with all $462 + 6 \times 315 = 2{,}352$ correction columns (exact rank $1{,}486$) raises the necessary diagonal quadratic rank on $(a_0, a_1, a_2, a_3, a_4)$ from $4$ to **$9$** (compared to $7$ in `cycle-three`; `21,168` correction annihilation pairings verified). In RREF over $\mathbb{Q}$:

$$\begin{aligned}
Q_1 &: \quad a_0^2 - \frac{4}{3}a_0 a_4 + \frac{5}{6}a_1 a_2 + \frac{1}{3}a_1 a_3 - a_1 a_4 - \frac{5}{18}a_2^2 - \frac{2}{9}a_2 a_3 + \frac{5}{18}a_2 a_4 + \frac{47}{36}a_3^2 - \frac{14}{9}a_3 a_4 + \frac{17}{9}a_4^2 = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_2 &: \quad a_0 a_1 + a_0 a_4 - \frac{1}{2}a_1^2 - \frac{1}{4}a_1 a_2 + \frac{1}{2}a_1 a_3 + \frac{5}{12}a_2^2 - \frac{1}{6}a_2 a_3 + \frac{1}{12}a_2 a_4 + \frac{5}{12}a_3^2 + \frac{5}{6}a_3 a_4 - \frac{5}{6}a_4^2 = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_3 &: \quad \frac{1}{4}a_2(4 a_0 + a_1 - 5 a_2 + 4 a_3 + a_4) = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_4 &: \quad \frac{1}{4}a_3(4 a_0 + a_1 + a_2 - 2 a_3 + a_4) = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_5 &: \quad a_0 a_4 - \frac{3}{4}a_1 a_3 + a_1 a_4 + \frac{1}{4}a_2 a_3 + \frac{1}{2}a_3^2 + \frac{1}{4}a_3 a_4 - a_4^2 = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_6 &: \quad a_1^2 - \frac{2}{3}a_1(a_2 + a_3 + a_4) + \frac{5}{9}(a_2^2 + a_3^2 + a_4^2) - \frac{2}{9}(a_2 a_3 + a_2 a_4 + a_3 a_4) = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_7 &: \quad a_1 a_2 - a_1 a_4 - \frac{7}{3}a_2^2 + \frac{34}{15}a_2 a_3 + \frac{4}{5}a_2 a_4 - \frac{53}{30}a_3^2 - \frac{2}{3}a_3 a_4 + \frac{1}{5}a_4^2 = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_8 &: \quad \frac{1}{3}(a_3 - a_4)(3 a_1 - a_2 - 2 a_3 + a_4) = 0, \\[3pt]
Q_9 &: \quad a_1 a_4 + \frac{28}{3}a_2^2 - \frac{206}{15}a_2 a_3 - \frac{13}{15}a_2 a_4 + \frac{427}{30}a_3^2 - \frac{2}{3}a_3 a_4 + \frac{13}{15}a_4^2 = 0.
\end{aligned}$$

- **Cubic Macaulay Elimination (`35 / 35` Full Rank):** Multiplying $Q_1,\dots,Q_9$ by $a_0,\dots,a_4$ produces $45$ rows in the $\binom{5+3-1}{3} = 35$ cubic monomials with **exact rank $35/35$**, forcing $a_0^3 = a_1^3 = a_2^3 = a_3^3 = a_4^3 = 0$ over $\mathbb{C}$.
- **Quartic Macaulay Elimination (`70 / 70` Full Rank):** Multiplying $Q_1,\dots,Q_9$ by the $15$ quadratic monomials $a_i a_j$ produces $135$ rows in the $\binom{5+4-1}{4} = 70$ quartic monomials with **exact rank $70/70$**, exporting 5 verified fourth-power identities $a_0^4 = a_1^4 = a_2^4 = a_3^4 = a_4^4 = 0$ (`2,240` rational multiplier products verified).
- Consequently $a_0 = a_1 = a_2 = a_3 = a_4 = 0$ over $\mathbb{C}$, so $D = 6 a_5 F \in \mathbb{C}\cdot F$, violating $\gcd(F, D) = 1$. **All coprime certificate denominators of degree $d \le 6$ for `one-reflection-skew` are excluded over $\mathbb{C}$.**
